rationale: The round-2 positions remain substantively incompatible on the core issues: works council/union and state shareholder reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, family holding, and investors still keep them on the table if alternatives do not match the savings. There is some narrowing toward negotiated burden-sharing, but no durable convergence on the size, permanence, or instruments of restructuring, so another round could still test concrete scenarios.
